data.name: Delawar
data.gender_notes: Delawar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Delawar is derived from the Arabic roots 'd-l-w-r', meaning 'exalted' and 'warrior'. In Islamic history, this name symbolizes a righteous warrior, one who is both brave and noble in their pursuit of justice. The name Delawar carries the meaning “Exalted warrior” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Delawar usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of strength and courage, Delawar is a reminder of the spiritual warrior within us all.
data.etymology: Delawar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Delawar total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
